review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its definitions against Mathlib concepts. The definitions are tartarAmplitudeSecondDerivativeIntegrand, tartarAmplitudeSecondDerivative, tartarTestFunctionSecondDerivativeBound, tartarTestFunctionSecondDerivative, poitouKernelDerivative, poitouVerticalProfileDerivative, poitouKernelSecondDerivative, poitouVerticalProfileSecondDerivative, regularizedPoitouVerticalProfile and regularizedScaledTartarSecondDerivative. All of them are explicit closed-form expressions for specific derivatives, built so the file can state HasDerivAt and domination bounds. Mathlib's `deriv`, `iteratedDeriv`, `Real.fourier_deriv` and `𝓕` are already used where they fit. I considered `iteratedDeriv 2` as a replacement, but it would lose the explicit formulas that the bounds need. Those definitions are therefore an intentional representation, not a duplicate concept. I found no definition that duplicates an existing Mathlib structure or concept. The one candidate that is only a lemma, `abs_sinh_le_cosh`, has no match in Mathlib by grep. Theorem-level duplication is outside this rubric. I did not trace the upstream project files (e.g. poitouKernel in other modules) in detail.
